## Descriptor and inventory vocabulary

Broad descriptor families: `service`, `provider`, `tool`, `command`, `prompt_section`, `waterfall`, `user_interface`, `external_process`, `diagnostic`.

Exact inventory namespaces: `service`, `inference_provider`, `agent_runtime`, `model_catalog`, `token_counter`, `catalog_persistence`, `credential_provider`, `authorization_flow`, `settings_provider`, `settings_namespace`, `web_provider`, `web_processor`, `tool`, `native_tool`, `request_transform`, `command`, `prompt_section`, `skill`, `agent_preset`, `agent_preset_fallback`, `subagent_provider`, `hook`, `theme`, `mcp_server`, `interception_seam`, `interception_layer`, `user_interface`, `ui_slot`, `external_process`, `doctor_check`, `telemetry_metric`, `app_server_method`.

Broad families state what a plugin may contribute. Exact inventory states which named service, command, tool, provider, process, or other row a committed activation actually owns.

## External plugin manifest v1

The manifest is strict (`deny_unknown_fields`). Fields classified optional are the only fields whose Rust wire type is `Option`; arrays remain required even when empty.

| Field | Wire type | Presence |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | `u32` | required |
| `id` | `string` | required |
| `name` | `string` | required |
| `version` | `string` | required |
| `description` | `string` | required |
| `license` | `string` | required |
| `api` | `ApiRange` | required |
| `contributions` | `array<Contribution>` | required |
| `configuration_schema` | `string` | optional |
| `requested_permissions` | `array<PluginPermission>` | required |
| `default_enabled` | `bool` | required |
| `platforms` | `array<Platform>` | required |
| `source` | `Source` | required |
| `dependencies` | `array<Dependency>` | required |
| `conflicts` | `array<string>` | required |
| `authentication` | `Authentication` | required |
| `code` | `Code` | optional |

### Closed manifest vocabulary

| Vocabulary | Accepted values |
|---|---|
| Contribution kinds | `skill`, `command`, `agent`, `hook`, `theme`, `provider`, `mcp` |
| Requested permissions | `filesystem_read`, `filesystem_write`, `network_access`, `process_spawn`, `credential_use`, `mcp_connect`, `hook_registration`, `contribution_override` |
| Operating systems | `macos`, `linux`, `windows`, `freebsd` |
| Architectures | `aarch64`, `x86_64` |
| Authentication policy | `none`, `optional`, `required` |
| Source kinds | `local`, `git`, `https`, `registry`, `marketplace` |
| Signature algorithms | `ed25519` |
| Update channels | `stable`, `preview`, `pinned` |

### Canonical validated fixture

```toml
schema_version = 1
id = "acme/code-quality"
name = "Code Quality"
version = "1.2.3-beta.1+build.7"
description = "Review code with the Acme quality workflow."
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
default_enabled = false
configuration_schema = "schemas/config.schema.json"
requested_permissions = ["filesystem_read", "network_access", "credential_use"]
platforms = [
  { os = "macos", architecture = "aarch64" },
  { os = "linux", architecture = "x86_64" },
]
dependencies = [
  { id = "acme/shared", minimum_version = "1.0.0", maximum_version_exclusive = "2.0.0", optional = false },
]
conflicts = ["legacy/code-quality"]

[api]
minimum = 1
maximum = 2

[source]
kind = "https"
locator = "https://plugins.example.test/acme/code-quality.tar.zst"
checksum = "sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
signature = { algorithm = "ed25519", key_id = "acme/releases", value = "YWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYWFhYQ==" }
update_channel = "stable"

[authentication]
policy = "required"
credentials = [{ reference = "acme/code-quality/api", kind = "api-key" }]

[[contributions]]
kind = "skill"
id = "review"
path = "skills/review/SKILL.md"
exposure = { mode = "namespaced" }

[[contributions]]
kind = "command"
id = "quality"
path = "commands/quality.toml"
exposure = { mode = "namespaced" }
```

A manifest proves validated metadata, not installation, signature validity, activation, or product reachability. Managed admission and lifecycle state remain separate commit gates.
